nodes.description: Public mapping(address => uint) storing token balances of holders; directly mutated in the MarsShiba contract.
Public nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint)) tracking spending approvals; mutated with unchecked subtraction in transferFrom.
Public uint holding the total token supply, set once in the constructor.
Public string token name set in the constructor.
Public string token symbol set in the constructor.
Private address owner; set from msg.sender in constructor and used as an access-control gate in delegate, batchSend and the ensure modifier.
Internal constant address 0x7a250d...488D (Uniswap router) granted an infinite allowance in the constructor.
Public constant uint decimals = 18 used for display only.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom guarded by the ensure modifier; performs unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic and mutates balanceOf/allowance.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no input validation.
Owner-only function that performs an arbitrary delegatecall to a user-supplied address with user-supplied calldata, allowing full storage takeover.
Owner-only batch transfer that computes total = _value * _tos.length and mutates balanceOf in a loop, emitting duplicated Transfer events with _value/2.
Internal pure helper computing the CREATE2 address of a Uniswap V2 pair from factory, token0, token1 and the init code hash.
Payable constructor initializing name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, balances and an infinite allowance to the router, including uint(-1) cast.
Caller-controlled address used throughout for authentication, ownership and balance/allowance indexing.
Low-level delegatecall to an arbitrary user-supplied address executed inside the owner-only delegate function, exposing complete contract state to malicious code.
Unchecked arithmetic in batchSend: total = _value * _tos.length and balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total can overflow/underflow and mis-account balances.
Unchecked allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value in transferFrom can underflow when the spender approval is stale or manipulated.
uint(-1) cast in the constructor sets an effectively infinite allowance to the router address, permanently granting unlimited transferFrom rights on the owner's balance.
Destination address parameter of transfer, forwarded to transferFrom.
Source address parameter of transferFrom, checked in the ensure modifier and used as balanceOf/allowance key.
Amount parameter of transferFrom used in unchecked allowance and balance arithmetic.
Spender address parameter of approve used as the allowance mapping key.
Arbitrary target address parameter of delegate, passed to the low-level delegatecall.
Arbitrary calldata parameter of delegate, executed in the contract context via delegatecall.
Array of recipient addresses in batchSend; its length feeds the unchecked multiplication.
Per-recipient amount in batchSend; multiplied by the recipient count without overflow protection.
Token name constructor parameter stored into the name state variable.
Token symbol constructor parameter stored into the symbol state variable.
Initial supply constructor parameter assigned to totalSupply and to the deployer's balance.
Local variable total = _value * _tos.length in batchSend, computed with unchecked multiplication.
Local variable pair in pairFor holding the CREATE2-derived Uniswap pair address returned to the ensure modifier.

edges.reason: transfer forwards msg.sender as the _from argument of transferFrom, so the caller fully determines the debited account.
msg.sender indexes allowance[_from][msg.sender] in transferFrom, making the spender identity caller-controlled.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender], so the owner key comes directly from the caller.
The only guard in delegate is require(msg.sender == owner), so authority derives solely from the caller address.
The only guard in batchSend is require(msg.sender == owner), gating unlimited batch transfers.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to the deployer.
transfer delegates all work to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
transferFrom subtracts from balanceOf[_from] and adds to balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath.
Execution reaches the raw allowance subtraction whenever msg.sender != _from, enabling underflow of the approval.
approve overwrites allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with the caller-supplied value.
batchSend mutates balanceOf[msg.sender] and each balanceOf[_to] inside the loop with unchecked math.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length and subtracts it from the caller balance without overflow/underflow checks.
The owner-only delegate function reaches an arbitrary delegatecall, letting external code re-enter and rewrite all storage.
The constructor sets owner from msg.sender, establishing the privileged account.
The constructor assigns totalSupply = _supply.
The constructor sets balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply, minting the full supply to the deployer.
The constructor writes allowance[msg.sender][router] = uint(-1).
The constructor assigns name = _name.
The constructor assigns symbol = _symbol.
The constructor executes uint(-1) which casts to the maximum uint, granting an unlimited router allowance.
The ensure modifier attached to transferFrom calls pairFor to derive the allowed Uniswap pair address.
The ensure modifier compares _from/_to against the stored owner, so owner state gates transferFrom.
The UNI constant address is used as the spender key when the constructor writes the infinite allowance.
The _to parameter of transfer is passed through to transferFrom as the recipient.
The _from parameter is used as the balanceOf and allowance key and is validated by ensure.
The _value parameter feeds the unchecked allowance and balance subtractions.
The _spender parameter becomes the key of the allowance mapping entry written by approve.
The address parameter a of delegate is the target of the low-level delegatecall.
The bytes parameter b of delegate is the calldata executed in the contract storage context.
The _tos array drives the loop and its length is multiplied by _value to compute total.
_tos.length is an operand of the unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length.
The _value parameter is credited to each recipient and emitted in duplicated Transfer events.
_value is an operand of the unchecked multiplication and of the balance subtraction.
The local total computed as _value * _tos.length is the value subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender] without checks.
The constructor parameter _name flows into the name state variable.
The constructor parameter _symbol flows into the symbol state variable.
The constructor parameter _supply flows into totalSupply and the deployer balance.
_supply is assigned directly to the totalSupply state variable in the constructor.
The local pair variable computed by pairFor is returned to the calling ensure modifier.

normalization_plan.reason: _to_transfer is a parameter whose only role is to be forwarded into the transfer function, so it collapses into the transfer core node.
_from_transferFrom is a transferFrom parameter used solely inside that function for balance/allowance indexing, so it merges into transferFrom.
_value_transferFrom is a transferFrom parameter only consumed by that function's arithmetic, so it merges into transferFrom.
_spender_approve is an approve-only parameter used as the allowance key, so it merges into approve.
a_delegate is only used as the delegatecall target inside delegate, so it merges into the delegate core function.
b_delegate is only used as the delegatecall calldata inside delegate, so it merges into the delegate core function.
_tos_batchSend is an input of batchSend whose length drives the loop, so it merges into the batchSend core function.
_value_batchSend is the per-recipient amount of batchSend and merges into the batchSend core function.
_name_constructor is only stored during construction, so it merges into the constructor core function.
_symbol_constructor is only stored during construction, so it merges into the constructor core function.
_supply_constructor is only used to seed supply and balances in the constructor, so it merges into the constructor core function.
The local total variable in batchSend exists only to hold the unchecked multiplication/subtraction result, so it merges into the batchSend_arithmetic unsafe operation.
The local pair variable in pairFor only holds the computed CREATE2 address and merges into the pairFor core function.
